summary: Feed c041_nic is degraded: APM eth1 is discarding 2.05% of packets (52,860 discards) because its capture pipeline cannot keep up. Link health is good, so loss is tool-side oversubscription causing incomplete APM visibility.

findings.root_cause: APM eth1 NIC/host capture stack is oversubscribed and discarding packets after receipt. Broker is delivering more pps/bandwidth than the single 10G APM interface can process (2.05% loss vs 0.1% threshold). Not a link error or broker drop - discards counted at the tool interface itself.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will have gaps in flow/transaction reconstruction, inaccurate latency and error-rate calculations, and missed application performance issues. ~1 in 50 packets lost randomly at the tool breaks both directions of monitored flows.

recommended_fix.why: Loss is at the tool NIC (tool could not keep up), not in transit. Reduce offered load to this APM via packet-broker load_balance across multiple APM instances, filter to only APM-relevant traffic, or enable slicing (APM needs_full_payload=false) and/or upgrade APM capture capacity/NIC tuning.
